show:hidden histories.name: Hidden Histories of WWII
show:hidden histories.summary:
Internationally renowned historian and broadcaster, James Holland, takes a deep dive into key events from the Second World War, bringing incredible stories to life for a new generation, and offering new research and analysis to enhance our understanding of the most consequential war of the 20th Century.

Each episode follows Holland buddying up with a fellow expert companion to explore the locations, characters and hardware that bring each story to life. Holland and his guests travel to Lyon to learn about the downfall of the French Resistance leader, Jean Moulin; to Rauray to follow an epic tank battle; to Monte Cassino in the footsteps of the incredible Polish forces, and across the UK to explore how the development of a single aircraft contributed to making possible the D-Day landings.

On location, we get a sense of how each story played out, alongside Holland's re-telling, and the interpretation of its importance and impact as he analyses each event with his companion, illustrated with archive imagery, records and animated sequences.

show:shaun the sheep.summary: One of Aardman Animations' best-loved characters stars in his own series. Set on a remote rural farm, Shaun's flock live a peaceful life under the watchful eye of their sheepdog Bitzer

episodes:704.name: Off the Baa!
episodes:704.summary: Children's animation set on a remote rural farm. Shaun's flock lives a peaceful life under the watchful eye of their sheepdog Bitzer, but Shaun's insatiable curiosity often leads him into the unlikeliest adventures. A cabbage from a passing truck bounces into the field and Shaun decides to use it as a football, but the pigs are out to spoil the sheep's game.

episodes:704.name: Bathtime
episodes:704.summary: Children's animation featuring the curious young sheep. The flock does not want to wash in freezing sheep dip, so Shaun hijacks the hot water from the farmer's bathtub.

episodes:704.name: Shape Up with Shaun
episodes:704.summary: Children's animation set on a remote rural farm. Shirley the sheep has put on weight, so Shaun helps her get in shape with a rigorous exercise regime.

episodes:704.name: Timmy in a Tizzy
episodes:704.summary: Children's animation. On a remote rural farm, Shaun's flock lives a peaceful life under the watchful eye of their sheepdog Bitzer. But Shaun's insatiable curiosity often leads him into the unlikeliest adventures. When the Farmer takes Timmy's favourite sheep dolly, the little lamb won't stop crying. So Shaun rallies the flock to get it back from Pidsley, the farm cat!

episodes:704.name: Scrumping
episodes:704.summary: Animation about the adventures of Shaun the Sheep. Shaun's attempts to get his hands on some apples from a tree overhanging the naughty pigs' yard cause trouble.

episodes:704.name: Bitzer Puts His Foot in It
If You Can't Stand the Heat
We Wish Ewe a Merry Christmas
Checklist
episodes:704.summary: Animated Series. Bitzer's over-officious management style becomes too much for the sheep, who decide it's time for him to chill out. Bitzer's tasks for the day take on a new purpose, for everyone to have some fun.

episodes:704.name: Return to Sender
episodes:704.summary: Animated Series. The Farmer receives a mystery gift from his antipodean cousin. Unimpressed with the present, he attempts to throw it away, only for it to keep reappearing. He becomes convinced it has magical powers.

episodes:704.name: Cone of Shame
episodes:704.summary: Animated Series. Bitzer is an all-too willing volunteer when he has to wear the cone of shame and is happy to let the flock wait on him. That is, until Shaun rumbles his malingering and plots the pooch's comeuppance.

episodes:704.name: Sheep Farmer
episodes:704.summary: Animated Series. When Timmy sees a particularly grumpy farmer giving one of the flock a hard time, he decides to give him an idea of what it's like to be a sheep. But when the time comes to have the old farmer back, things aren't quite so simple.

episodes:704.name: Bake it Easy
episodes:704.summary: Despite warnings, the sheep have gobbled up the birthday cake Bitzer has baked for the Farmer. Realising the kitchen cupboards are bare, Shaun and the flock must try and source ingredients for a new one from around the farm before Bitzer realises. The result is certainly a surprise!

episodes:704.name: Shelf Life
episodes:704.summary: When the Farmer accidentally drills a hole in a waterpipe while putting up a new shelf, Bitzer frantically tries to stop the leak from soaking the living room and prevent the Farmer's precious teapots from sliding off the shelf!

episodes:704.name: Bed Lamb
episodes:704.summary: Shaun tricks Bitzer into thinking he is unwell so that he can stay in the barn playing video games all day. However, before long, the other sheep are also pulling sickies, and Bitzer is starting to get suspicious. The threat of nasty medicine has everyone out of bed in a flash!

episodes:704.name: Shooting Stars
episodes:704.summary: When a meteor shower is forecast to pass over Mossy Bottom, Bitzer really wants to see the shooting stars. However, he keeps getting distracted by the flock's curiosity and the Farmer's late-night picnic.

episodes:704.name: Doorbell
episodes:704.summary: While proudly testing his new doorbell camera, the Farmer realises he has locked himself out. Bitzer must help his boss get back into the farmhouse while simultaneously making sure he doesn't spot Timmy and Shaun with a runaway kite.

episodes:704.name: Bee Free
episodes:704.summary: The Farmer has taken up beekeeping and is loving all the honey produced by the hive. However, when he discards his protective suit, the swarm move in, bringing it to life! Soon, the ‘Bee-Man' is bossing Bitzer around.

episodes:704.name: Hoof Fashion
episodes:704.summary: Shaun steps in a can of red paint, and his resulting red hoof makes him a style icon on the farm. Before long, the rest of the flock try their own new looks and soon steal the limelight. As the outfits become more and more outrageous, Shaun wonders if less might sometimes be more.

episodes:704.name: Bitzer's Bale Out
episodes:704.summary: The Farmer tasks Bitzer with baling up a fresh haystack, but the hungry sheep have hidden inside and are turned into moving bales. A wild game of chase the bale results as Bitzer tries to restore order to the hay field.

episodes:704.name: Whistle-Stop
episodes:704.summary: Realising that Bitzer has a series of whistles which can control the flock's movements, Shaun steals them and soon has the flock dancing to his tune. When the Farmer finds the whistles stuck together like a harmonica, his dreadful playing gives Shaun a taste of his own medicine.

episodes:704.name: Ruffing It
episodes:704.summary: Renovations force Bitzer to camp out for the night. When the flock are shut out of the barn, they must also pitch up in the field. The sheep are loving their trendy glampsite at first, but as the weather worsens and batteries run low, the appeal of Bitzer's practical tent grows.

episodes:704.name: Power Cut
episodes:704.summary: With the Farmer and Bitzer out at the Golden Tractor Awards, the flock take the chance to enjoy all the mod cons of the house – until they overload the power and the house is plunged into total darkness. When the Farmer returns, the flock must escape the house without getting caught.

episodes:704.name: Stuck in the Muck
episodes:704.summary: After the Farmer manages to drive his tractor into a mud patch, Shaun, Bitzer and the flock try to rescue it from the quagmire. Before long, however, the stranded vehicle sinks far beyond their reach.

episodes:704.name: Spare Parts
episodes:704.summary: When two different pieces of flat-pack furniture are delivered to the Farmer and Bitzer, confusion ensues as they start to mix up the pieces. Shaun and the Flock are forced to give them a lesson in following instructions.

episodes:704.name: Sleep on It
episodes:704.summary: An all-night gaming session turns the Farmer and Bitzer into sleep-deprived zombies the next day. Shaun takes the chance to change Bitzer's checklist to suit himself, but he manages to miss the final item: shearing time!

episodes:704.name: Treasure Hunt
episodes:704.summary: Bitzer is horrified when the farmer scribbles all over his map showing the location of his buried bone and fears he will never rediscover his treasure. The flock are on hand to help him search, even if their methods are unorthodox.

episodes:704.name: Gone to the Dogs
episodes:704.summary: Bitzer is embarrassed when his dad makes a surprise visit and finds the farmyard in a mess. Feeling sorry for Bitzer, Shaun and the flock make a real show of tidying up. Bitzer and his dad get some bonding time, but as soon as dad leaves, the place descends into anarchy once more.

episodes:704.name: Shirleyverse, Part 1
episodes:704.summary: Shaun escapes through a ‘portal' inside Shirley's wool to flee an annoying Bitzer, only to emerge into a chaotic version of the farm without him. Desperate to escape, he repeatedly jumps back inside Shirley, emerging somewhere worse each time!

episodes:704.name: Shirleyverse, Part 2
episodes:704.summary: Shaun escapes through a ‘portal' inside Shirley's wool to flee an annoying Bitzer, only to emerge into a chaotic version of the farm without him. Desperate to escape, he repeatedly jumps back inside Shirley, emerging somewhere worse each time!

episodes:704.name: Poultrygeist
episodes:704.summary: When a chicken ends up inside Shaun's pillowcase, Shaun tries to get it back, only for the chicken to end up in the farmhouse and the Farmer to think he is being haunted.

episodes:704.name: Fleece Navidad
episodes:704.summary: When Farmer Ben delivers his perfect Christmas card, Shaun and the gang secretly knit jumpers to try and make sure the Mossy Bottom Farm card is even more spectacular. But getting everyone to pose for the photo proves to be harder than it looks.

show:roger.name: Roger Roger
show:roger.summary: Roger Roger was a BBC television comedy-drama written by John Sullivan. The series was about a mini-cab firm called Cresta Cabs.

previousepisode.name: Freedom's Just Another Word for Nothing Left to Lose

episodes:13047.name: Even Quasimodo Pulled
episodes:13047.summary: A new communications system causes problems at Cresta Cabs. Sam and Reen accidentally broadcast a private conversation to all cabs. Sam's partner Dexter returns from abroad after a breakdown caused by his unfaithful wife Tina.

episodes:13047.name: I Used to Be a Superb Rugby Player
episodes:13047.summary: Cresta Cabs is short of drivers, but Dexter has not returned to work yet. He wrongly suspects Tina of being unfaithful again and gets Cambridge to destroy an expensive painting he bought her, not realizing that Cambridge is in someone else's house.

episodes:13047.name: Socks with Little Tennis Players on Them
episodes:13047.summary: Dexter sees the insurance salesman Tina had an affair with at his house. He jumps into the Thames, and soon afterwards the insurance salesman's body is found in the boot of one of the mini-cabs.

episodes:13047.name: There Are No Minicabs in Heaven
episodes:13047.summary: Sam makes the arrangements for Dexter's funeral but things don't go as planned. Henry drives a pregnant woman to the hospital and is mistaken for the baby's father.

episodes:13047.name: Some Get the Magic, Some Get the Tragic
episodes:13047.summary: Baz finally connects with one of his dates, but he learns that Andre is the father of her son. Rajiv is mugged in his mini-cab and is afraid to return to work. Sam asks for Rajiv's help with the company accounts and learns that Dexter embezzled large amounts of money.

episodes:13047.name: The Day the Music Died
episodes:13047.summary: Phil is promised a spot for his band in a talent show if he can acquire a boa constrictor for one of his agent's other clients. Marlon gets a job in a grocery store. Sam goes to visit his wife who is in a nursing home with early-onset Alzheimer's.

episodes:13047.name: Welcome to Responsibilityville
episodes:13047.summary: Cresta Cabs is in financial difficulties after Dexter stole money from the company. His wife Tina loses her house and shows up on Sam's doorstep, interrupting an intimate moment with Reen. Cambridge is tricked into skinny dipping by two female passengers who take his clothes and mini-cab.

episodes:13047.name: Every Victim Wishes He'd Kept His Clothes On
episodes:13047.summary: Sam is unable to resist Tina's advances. Phil is in debt to a recording studio. He has car trouble while driving a businessman from the airport and later returns a wallet the man left in his cab.

episodes:13047.name: Sometimes It's Hard to Be a Man
episodes:13047.summary: Reen learns about Sam and Tina. Upset about Phil's debt, Chrissie takes the kids to her mother's. Phil accepts an offer to work as a driver to Mr. Eugene, the businessman whose wallet he returned. Marlon is taken advantage of by a girl and her friends.

episodes:13047.name: Ask the 1975 Millwall Defence
episodes:13047.summary: Tina continues to insinuate herself into Sam's life. Phil realizes that Chrissie has left him. Sam tries to get an important contract for Cresta Cabs but the meeting is a disaster. Rajiv is offered a partnership in Cresta Cabs. Baz wakes up in bed with the owner of his dating agency.

episodes:13047.name: I'm Not a Little Baby and Daddy Hasn't Gone to Japan
episodes:13047.summary: Tina shows no signs of leaving Sam's house. Sam gets the important contract for Cresta Cabs and goes out to dinner with the company's owner, Helen Jackson. Marlon is tricked into letting some kids steal from the shop where he works. The owner of Baz's dating agency is shocked when he rejects her. Mr. Eugene asks Phil to deliver some packages and hire female escorts for a party.

episodes:13047.name: Too Much Wine, Too Many Stars
episodes:13047.summary: Andre meets a young girl in a bar, and Sam goes out with Helen Jackson, but they discover that the girl is Andre's daughter with Helen. Phil brings escorts to Mr. Eugene's party where cocaine is being served.

episodes:13047.name: Love Rules the Heart, Money Takes the Soul
episodes:13047.summary: Tina learns about Helen and moves out. Reen tells Sam she and her husband are trying to save their relationship. Sam gets caught in an explosion when Barry's mechanic brothers-in-law dump petrol down the toilet. Reen overhears Sam confessing his feelings for her. Phil is arrested and learns that he's been delivering drugs for Mr. Eugene. He agrees to wear a wire but Mr. Eugene reveals that he is untouchable because of the high-powered men who were at his party.

episodes:13047.name: Play It Again, Sam
episodes:13047.summary: Sam is conned out of a fleet of mini-cabs by a woman claiming to be an old acquaintance.

episodes:13047.name: Thank God It Wasn't Boat Race Day
episodes:13047.summary: Dexter returns and reveals to Sam that he faked his death, but they are unable to tell anyone because of the insurance salesman Dexter killed.

episodes:13047.name: Freedom's Just Another Word for Nothing Left to Lose
episodes:13047.summary: Sam punches Reen's husband Tommy because he thinks he abused her. He later learns Tommy is dead and wrongly assumes he killed him. Sam and Dexter go on the run. Sam tells his therapist that Dexter is alive, but Dr. Geoff thinks Sam is hallucinating and has him committed to a mental hospital.

show:back to back.name: Back to Back Chef
show:back to back.summary: In each episode, a celebrity chef challenges an amateur to keep up with him or her as they make a dish in 15 minutes, with one big caveat: The amateur can't see the chef—they can only listen.

previousepisode.name: Troye Sivan Tries to Keep Up With a Professional Chef

episodes:45513.name: Gordon Ramsay Challenges Amateur Cook to Keep Up with Him
episodes:45513.summary: In just 15 minutes and with his back turned, Gordon Ramsay challenges an amateur to keep up with him as he makes crab cakes. He's also teaching a four hour Masterclass demonstrating his techniques to help you take your cooking to the next level.

episodes:45513.name: Bobby Flay Challenges Amateur Cook to Keep Up with Him
episodes:45513.summary: Chef Bobby Flay teaches amateur cook Shane how to make chile relleno (aka stuffed poblano peppers) using audio instructions only - no visuals whatsoever. Facing away from each other, back-to-back, these two men quickly progress through the chile relleno recipe. As Flay barks out directions, Shane scrambles to follow. Can Shane beat Bobby Flay at his own game? Probably not. But, it's fun to watch him try to keep up in this fast-paced cooking challenge.

episodes:45513.name: Daniel Boulud Challenges Amateur Cook to Keep Up with Him

Without the benefit of visual aids, Jessica must keep up with chef Boulud's hurried audio instructions (and accent). An updated version of Daniel Boulud's book "Letters to a Young Chef" came out on October 3. In it, he shares the story of his career and the lessons he has learned along the way.

episodes:45513.name: Marlon Wayans Tries to Keep Up with Carla

Without the benefit of visual aids, Marlon must keep up with Carla's instructions. Marlon Wayans' comedy special "Woke-ish" is out on Netflix.

show:monsuno.summary: Meteors fell to the planet. These meteors carried LIFE – in the form of powerful, chaotic, uncontrollable genetic material.
